title: Current TOPS-20 / KL10 continuation frontier
summary: Preserve the qualified baseline and distinguish event convergence from machine-state convergence: the historical pre_041342 fixture correctly reproduces the CST-age-zero fetch event, but its wider CPU/APR state is not equivalent to the newly authentic 512K replay arrival.
procedure: Treat f8a304b as the qualified restart baseline unless a later qualified KL10 package explicitly supersedes it.
Keep the historical 256K default behavior distinguishable from an explicit KL10B minimum-memory profile; do not silently enlarge every machine.
Qualify the explicit 1024-page / 512K-word memory profile through both EXB and raw-tape loading paths.
Replay the preserved pre_nxm_refusal state with the second 256K installed and confirm that 071724 SETZM and 071730 BLT no longer signal NXM.
Use the historical pre_041342 fixture only as an event oracle: its next fetch must fault with CST_AGE_ZERO at VA 041342, page-fail word 001000,,041342, vector 044414, and post-fault ICOUNT 1253190.
Do not use historical pre_041342 as a complete-machine restart point: its APR and several AC left halves differ from the newly authentic replay report.

Produce a new frozen checkpoint from the authentic 512K replay immediately before the 041342 fetch and compare full AC blocks, pager/APR state, UPT/TLB, CST entries, serialized memory, and page-fail frame against the historical fixture.
Only promote state that is reached from the authentic 512K path and passes the wider regression suite.
invariants: The earlier 071724/071730 NXM was caused by the configured 256K physical-memory boundary, not malformed PNRCOD and not BLT retirement semantics.
POSTLD deliberately relocates NRCOD into section 1 and records the relocated address in PNRCOD; PGRINI allocates CST storage after that image.
With 512K words installed, the preserved replay executes 10,848 additional authentic instructions and reaches 041342 with APR flags reported as zero.
The historical pre_041342 fixture is event-convergent but not full-state-convergent: its one-step fault is genuine, while APR=002000 and AC0/AC2/AC17 retain different left halves.
Historical pre_041342 may serve as a focused CST-age-zero regression oracle but not as an unquestioned continuation checkpoint.
Do not revive the old bogus NXM/BUGHLT future or synthetic UPT/TLB fixes merely because they reach a familiar downstream PC.
